title: News with read state: a dated diary that remembers, and a count in the menu
intent: News that remembers what was read
summary: A list of `<article>` entries with `<time datetime>` whose read state lives in one localStorage record behind a probe and try/catch (memory when the browser refuses, with the page saying so); a first visit treats the 21 days before the newest entry as new, a return visit gives entries dated after the newest one last seen a quiet arrival (a 3 px rust rule drawn `scaleX 0 → 1` over 900 ms, 140 ms apart, out of a 2.4 s colour wash); unread entries carry a New mark in their `<h2>` text plus a bold title and the rule; an entry is read when its native `<details>` opens or when it sits wholly in view below the sticky header for 1.2 s once the visitor has scrolled (never on load); the menu link reads `News 3 new` in text, Mark all as read turns `aria-disabled` at zero, and a polite status speaks only for the visitor's acts, gathering scroll reads for 600 ms; reduced motion keeps the wash and the fades and drops the drawing rule and the rising body
variants: read on open or dwell, a count in the menu, mark all (this, default)
read on open only: drop the dwell observer when entries are long and a glance is not a read
server-side: the same record keyed to a signed-in account, with localStorage as the offline copy
